locator.text: Equation (B.37), p. 156, in the proof of Proposition B.8

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. The identity P_c = (X_R x/L)G is stated, as `physical_projection`: the physical projection equals c.radius · familyProjection = X_R · (x/L)(Q_s + b N_s/(aE)), and the Lean's second shear component is b = shearB = -2XU_X/E, which is the paper's -b_s (the paper writes the shear vector as s = (a, -b_s)), so Q_s + bN_s/(aE) = Q_s - b_sN_s/(aE) = G. The two inequalities are not stated. The Lean never forms G separately and never uses the constants 6/7 and 3/7: instead `model_margins` bounds the whole projection from below by e^{-8}/2, by perturbation from the ideal control v = 0, where b = 0 and the projection reduces to xQ_s/L ≥ e^{-8} (`zero_projection_lower`, line 690, using Q_s ≥ 1 at the ideal profile); the floor is then multiplied by the radius to give 2 < P_c (line 1245). So the paper's chain G ≥ (6/7)Q_s ≥ 3Q_min/7 is replaced by a direct floor on P_c/X_R, and the conclusion the paper draws from (B.37) — P_c > 2 after increasing X_R, with no tolerance shrinking with X_R — is reached.
